title: Satchel: Travel Wallet
shortDescription: Keep trip details, ticket files and packing lists close at hand.
fullDescription:
Organise trip details, keep copies of ticket files and prepare a packing list. Save useful information before you leave and keep your trip details available on your phone. Export or import a trip file when you choose.

Check that every file you need is downloaded before travelling.
releaseBlockers: Android file viewer, vault and biometric QA

assets: Android device screenshots, 512px store icon and 1024x500 feature graphic still require verification
